items.intro_zh: 发帘是德宇的核心产品。发丝经分拣、双抽、顺鳞后在自有车间缝制，提供机制、手工与超薄无痕三类，纹理与色号可整套配套。
items.description_en: Double-drawn bundles with minimal shedding - the foundation of our wholesale business.
items.description_zh: 双抽工艺发束，掉发少，是批发业务的基础产品。
items.intro_en: Wefts are our core product. Hair is sorted, double-drawn and sewn in our own workshop, with cuticles kept in one direction. Machine wefts, hand-tied wefts and ultra-thin genius wefts are available in matching textures and colours.

items.intro_zh: 发块前头与发帘取自同一批发丝，整套安装的纹理、色泽与光泽保持一致。可选透明蕾丝、HD 蕾丝与丝网底，支持自由分缝、中分与三七分。
items.description_en: Small-lace pieces with a natural parting, made to match our wefts and bundles exactly.
items.description_zh: 小面积蕾丝补发片，分缝自然，可与同批号发帘完美配套。
items.intro_en: Closures and frontals are produced from the same hair batch as our wefts, so texture, colour and lustre stay consistent across a full install. Available in transparent, HD and silk-base lace with free, middle or three-part parting.

items.intro_zh: 马尾系列强调快速佩戴与稳固贴合，采用与发帘同等级的真人发，配缠绕式、抽绳式或抓夹式隐形固定结构。
items.description_en: Fast, secure attachment pieces in straight, wavy and curly textures.
items.description_zh: 佩戴快捷、固定牢靠，直发、波浪与卷发纹理齐备。
items.subtitle_zh: 缠绕式、抽绳式与抓夹马尾
items.intro_en: Our ponytail range is designed for quick, secure everyday wear. Each piece is made with the same graded human hair as our wefts and finished with a discreet wrap, drawstring or claw-clip attachment.

items.intro_zh: 我们的卡子发可以快速进行自我佩戴与稳固贴合，采用与发帘同等级的真人发，不同方位的头发进行添加
items.description_en: Clip-in hair pieces can be easily self-applied and secured snugly. Made of premium human hair of the same grade as hair wefts, they allow you to add hair volume at different positions.
items.description_zh: 片式卡子发可以快速进行自我佩戴与稳固贴合，采用与发帘同等级的真人发，不同方位的头发进行添加
items.intro_en: Clip-in hair pieces can be easily self-applied and secured snugly. Made of premium human hair of the same grade as hair wefts, they allow you to add hair volume at different positions.

items.intro_zh: Human hair bulk is loose human hair tied into bundles, with no sewn weft, clip, tape or keratin tip attached. It is not pre-made hair extensions, but the basic raw hair material for further processing.
items.description_en: Human hair bulk is loose human hair tied into bundles, with no sewn weft, clip, tape or keratin tip attached. It is not pre-made hair extensions, but the basic raw hair material for further processing.

items.intro_zh: Seamless Skin Weft is also known as injection tape hair extensions. Instead of sewing hair onto fabric tracks, the hair strands are injected onto an ultra-thin, flesh-toned flexible PU base which imitates human scalp. It lies completely flat against the head, invisible and lightweight.

items.intro_zh: Nano Ring Hair Extensions are tiny micro bead human hair extensions. The hair comes with a small nano metal tip, attached to natural hair using a tiny nano ring, with no glue, no tape, no heat. Lightweight, invisible, reusable, ideal for fine hair.

items.intro_zh: Micro Ring Hair Extensions (also called micro bead / micro loop hair extensions) are strand-by-strand human hair extensions fixed with silicone-lined micro metal beads. No glue, no heat, no tape needed. They are easier and faster to install than nano rings, suitable for medium & thick hair.

items.intro_zh: I Tip & U Tip Hair Extensions are pre-tipped human hair strands. I-tip has a straight stick tip; U-tip features a U-shaped keratin tip. They are applied by heat fusion or micro beads, no sewing, no tape. 100% human hair, reusable, can be dyed, bleached and heat styled.

items.intro_zh: Fan Tip Hair Extensions, also known as Y Tip extensions, feature a fan-shaped spread keratin tip. The hair strands fan out flat instead of bundling into a round stick. Installed with micro rings, no glue or heat. Ultra-flat, low-bulk, great for fine hair.

items.intro_zh: Feather Crochet Hair is pre-sectioned human hair connected by a thin invisible string at the center. It is installed with a crochet hook onto cornrows, knotless, lightweight and breathable. It creates soft wispy feather-like ends, ideal for boho braids, miracle knots and protective styles.

items.intro_zh: Tape in Hair Extensions are pre-taped weft hair extensions. Each piece is a thin hair weft attached to double-sided hair tape. They are installed by sandwiching your natural hair between two tape pieces. Lightweight, flat, invisible, fast to apply.

items.intro_zh: 头套系列包含前额蕾丝、全蕾丝、360 与免胶结构。全部在自有车间手工钩织，采用毛鳞片顺向真人发，出货前逐顶检查发际线、密度与掉发量。
items.description_en: Ready-to-wear wigs built on lace front, full lace and glueless bases, in every texture and length your market asks for.
items.subtitle_en: Lace front, full lace & glueless wigs
items.description_zh: 涵盖前额蕾丝、全蕾丝与免胶底，纹理与长度可按目标市场灵活配置。
items.subtitle_zh: 前额蕾丝、全蕾丝与免胶头套
items.intro_en: Our wig line covers lace front, full lace, 360 and glueless constructions. Every unit is hand-ventilated in our own workshop with cuticle-aligned human hair, then checked for hairline, density and shedding before packing.

items.intro_zh: Machine-Made Wigs are wigs made by sewing hair wefts onto a wig cap with sewing machines, instead of hand-tying on lace. Affordable, durable, easy to maintain. 100% human hair available. Great for daily wear, beginners and bulk orders. They cannot create an invisible scalp-like hairline as lace wigs do.

items.intro_zh: Customized Medical Wigs are specially tailored wigs for clients with hair loss caused by chemotherapy, alopecia and other medical conditions. They feature lightweight, soft, breathable caps .We customize cap size, hair density, color, length and hairline according to individual needs. Gentle for sensitive scalps.
